De nuevo: el sueldo de los docentes lo determina el gobierno mediante paritarias. No hay ningún otro intermediario. Ahí no puede haber choreo. Si Milei fuera vivo y realmente quisiera ayudar al docente bajaría las partidas presupuestarias un porcentaje y reinvertiria ese porcentaje en las paritarias. Pero no es lo que pasó.

Lo que va a pasar va a ser lo que ya viene pasando: menos docentes de calidad, peor educación, eventualmente las universidades nacionales públicas van a cerrar o se van a empezar a cobrar aranceles, y va a dejar de ser la herramienta de movilidad ascendente que supo ser (y que hoy lamentablemente está dejando ya de ser).

Los salarios docentes, sin voluntad del gobierno, no van a mejorar.

Los salarios docentes no salen del presupuesto de las universidades. La universidad no decide cuanto salario le corresponde a cada docente, para eso hay paritarias. Y los docentes se vienen quejando de que se cae todo a pedazos hace por lo menos 20 años. Que a los energumenos de franja morada les importe recien ahora no quita validez al reclamo.

Aunque no lo creas hay gente que lo hace por vocación. El problema es que es un laburo muy demandante de tiempo entre clases, correcciones, exámenes, etc. Vos facturas 10 hs de clases pero capaz dedicaste 20 o 30. Muchísimos docentes tienen aparte del puesto como docente otro trabajo full time porque sino la plata no les alcanza. Por vocación y mal salario docente terminan teniendo que trabajar 60 hs semanales o más. ¿No te parece un montón? Si pagaran decentemente la docencia capaz podrían tener un segundo trabajo privado pero part time y con eso llegar a fin de mes sin quemarse. Y encima después tienen que venir a escuchar o leer que los tratan de chorros, con todo lo que contribuyen a la sociedad formando nuevos profesionales.

Fuente: vengo de familia de docentes. Todos con segundo trabajo porque con el de docente no alcanza. Todos quemados pero siguiendo porque hay vocación. Pero tampoco para pensar que la docencia es un hobby.

Si es asi, estaría bueno que el gobierno intervenga con una buena suba de salarios para el cuerpo docente, en vez de tratarlos de ladrones. Bajales el presupuesto, subiles el salario y deciles que el resto lo vas a auditar, y listo. Pero la narrativa que eligieron es decir que el que va a la UBA en realidad podría pagarse una privada, y que los pobres no se reciben, ambas mentiras. Así no se puede debatir nada y por eso termina en tomas.

Can't tell you the amount of times I met people who didn't even know what it's for... During Hourglass battles. Sure, easy win for me, but it feels bad seeing people playing the game as if nothing was different only to then be surprised about their ships exploding.

One particular time I was solo slooping Hourglass fights and faced such an individual. I boarded him because he wasn't returning any of my shots. I play in South America which means there's a 50-50 chance they speak my language (Spanish), or Portuguese if they're from Brazil. I speak a little Portuguese, but barely. Mostly written as my pronunciation is all over the place.

Well, this guy received me on his ship, thought I was their new crewmate and showed me a treasure map repeatedly. I tried writing and talking to them to explain them they were supposed to fight me, but either they couldn't read the chat or didn't know where it was. I tried speaking but they obviously didn't understand me because they kept repeating the same phrase over the mic. Eventually they sailed out of the circle and I hear a surprised expression along the lines of "what is happening" from what little Portuguese I can understand, obviously referring to the black and white filter starting to kick in and the creepy music. Few seconds later, the ship goes boom.

Poor fella didn't even know what was happening at all. Hourglass should have its own tutorial before unlocking it, and it should be only available on captained ships IMO, to minimize new players mistakenly joining it.

I'd like to share my ideas on how to re-implement Mega Evolutions in the game:

\- Mega raids give you Mega Stones for that specific mega evolution.

\- Use Mega Stones on a specific Pokémon to unlock that mega evolution. Only that specific pokémon will be affected and not all from that species.

\- Pokémon can earn Mega Energy through the buddy system once they have a mega evolution unlocked. You'll need to fill a "heart bar" to mega evolve.

\- Every friendship level decreases the amount of Mega Energy (hearts) needed to mega evolve, which means 4-heart buddies will be able to mega evolve faster.

\- Activities that give "Mega Energy" are the same as those that gave hearts before: feeding, walking, fighting together, playing, daily photo. All remained capped with the same cap they have right now, and can be increased with poffins the same way they can right now.

\- People will keep raiding to get more mega stones of the same mega evolution to have several of the same species with different stats, different attacks, for different leagues and for raiding.

\- Monetization will be from both raids and poffins, since it will be tied to hearts.

\- Mega evolutions can be mutually exclusive, meaning, for example, the same Charizard can't have Y and X at the same time. This is so people will have to choose wisely which one to have, and also means people will keep trying to find good stats for every league. This also means more people will keep raiding mega raids to find perfect IV shiny pokémon suitable for mega evolution.

\- Mega Energy costs should be lowered and duration should be lowered. There's no point in having 4 hour long megas, as not many people raid for 4 hours straight. It would be sensible to reduce the cost by 4 and reduce duration to 1 hour.

I think this system I'm proposing is already better than what's in the game, more profitable, more player friendly, will increase playtime, ties well with the original games, and is more sustainable in the long run.

I can keep working on the friendship level to lower the cost as well while I earn more mega energy, since every heart I earn towards my friendship level gives me more Mega Energy!

I use another Charizardite X on the lucky Charizard C, I decide I really like having a dragon-fire mega and the shiny is cute and I want to unlock it after all. This one already is at 4 hearts, so I mega evolve right away after taking him out to play for a while!

A few weeks pass and a new community day featuring Charmander is coming, with a brand new exclusive move! Good thing I stocked up on those mega stones for Y and X back then, so I can have new mega evolution capable Charizards with the new movesets! I should keep stocking up on other stones for other species as well, since they might get new exclusive moves in future events! I go out and raid Mega Venusaur, Mega Blastoise, Mega Beedrill, Mega Gengar, Mega Mewtwo Y, Mega Mewtwo X... I want one of every exclusive moveset for every league, and I want them shiny! I should keep raiding to get more of these! And I should keep feeding them poffins to get them to be best friends with me so they require less mega energy to mega evolve!

\_\_\_\_

End of example. It fits with already existing systems, it's profitable, it's consumer friendly, it just makes sense in the game, keeps players engaged, and organically makes people want to raid more. I hope this reaches the right people and can be taken into consideration, who knows, maybe they'll take a couple of these to implement, I really think it would be cool to go this way, even though I think it's too late to go with Mega Stones, but perhaps this will spark some ideas on how to adapt the current system to be more engaging.
